title: HullQ Relationship Applicability Core v0.1
description: Shared core for all HullQ relationship records. Defines the stable relationship id, optional applicability/boundary fields, and the builder_role vocabulary. Compose into standalone and embedded relationship schemas via allOf/$ref. This schema intentionally has no unevaluatedProperties constraint — composing schemas apply that.

id.description: Stable opaque relationship ID. Independent of array position. Required in all forms (standalone and embedded).

first_year.description: First year this relationship was applicable. Null when unknown.

last_year.description: Last year this relationship was applicable. Null when unknown or still active.

hull_number_from.description: Inclusive hull/build number boundary from. Null when unknown.

hull_number_to.description: Inclusive hull/build number boundary to. Null when unknown.

market.description: Optional market/region label when the relationship was region-specific.

builder_role.description: Builder/manufacturer role vocabulary. Single definition shared by standalone OrganizationDesignRelationship and embedded BoatDesign builder records. Both forms $ref this definition.
